When an operator or automation invokes `devbox-ceremony-reset.sh --help`, this branch calls `usage`, which always exits with status 2. The command prints valid help but reports an invalid invocation to shells and documentation tooling; let the help path exit 0 while retaining status 2 for argument errors.
